observations: Photo 0 shows a gold-colored PlayStation 4 Slim console with the PS logo visible on the lid.
The console is placed on a stack of other consoles, suggesting a retail or storage environment.
The console appears to be in good physical condition with no visible damage.
The seller mentions 'special edition' and 'controller and other accessories' but no accessories are visible in the photo.
The console is not powered on; no screen or lights are visible.

claims.claim: Very clean ps4 slim special edition
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the console is clean and undamaged, but 'special edition' is not visible or verifiable from the photo. No model label or special edition markings are visible.
No accessories are visible in photo 0. The claim cannot be verified from the image alone.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may not be a special edition or may be a counterfeit
risks.proof: Photo showing the model label or serial number on the console, or a close-up of the console's body with visible special edition markings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a standard PS4 Slim, not a special edition.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal damage
risks.proof: Video or photo of the console powered on, showing the boot screen and system menu.

risks.risk: Controller and accessories may be missing or damaged
risks.proof: Photo showing the controller and any included accessories (e.g., power cable, HDMI cable, USB cable) laid out clearly.

Video or photo of the console powered on, showing the boot screen and system menu.
Photo of the controller and any included accessories laid out clearly.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
